label: MRtrix3 tcksample
description:
Sample values of an associated image along tracks
By default, the value of the underlying image at each point along the track is written to either an ASCII file (with all values for each track on the same line), or a track scalar file (.tsf). Alternatively, some statistic can be taken from the values along each streamline and written to a vector file.

parameters.label: stat_tck
parameters.description: compute some statistic from the values along each streamline (options are: mean,median,min,max)
parameters.usage: 使用原始命令参数；未指定的可选参数不传给软件。
parameters.software_default: 参见本机安装版本原始帮助。

parameters.label: nointerp
parameters.description: do not use trilinear interpolation when sampling image values

parameters.label: precise
parameters.description: use the precise mechanism for mapping streamlines to voxels (obviates the need for trilinear interpolation) (only applicable if some per-streamline statistic is requested)

parameters.label: use_tdi_fraction
parameters.description: each streamline is assigned a fraction of the image intensity in each voxel based on the fraction of the track density contributed by that streamline (this is only appropriate for processing a whole-brain tractogram, and images for which the quantiative parameter is additive)

parameters.label: quiet
parameters.description: do not display information messages or progress status; alternatively, this can be achieved by setting the MRTRIX_QUIET environment variable to a non-empty string.

parameters.label: nthreads
parameters.description: use this number of threads in multi-threaded applications (set to 0 to disable multi-threading).
parameters.usage: 使用原始命令参数；未指定的可选参数不传给软件。
parameters.software_default: 参见本机安装版本原始帮助。

output_slots.label: values
output_slots.description: the output sampled values This generic file port does not establish a specialized scientific artifact type; downstream use must match the documented contents, not merely the filename extension.
